title_vi: isn’t, haven’t, don’t v.v. (câu phủ định)
theory_html:
A. not (n’t) in negative sentences

A. not (n’t) trong câu phủ định

We use not (n’t) in negative sentences:

Dùng not (n’t) trong câu phủ định:

positive
khẳng định		negative
phủ định		example
ví dụ
amam not (’m not)I’m not tired.
isis not (isn’t or ’s not)It isn’t (or It’s not) raining.
areare not (aren’t or ’re not)They aren’t (or They’re not) here.
waswas not (wasn’t)Julian wasn’t hungry.
werewere not (weren’t)The shops weren’t open.
havehave not (haven’t)I haven’t finished my work.
hashas not (hasn’t)Sue hasn’t got a car.
willwill not (won’t)We won’t be here tomorrow.
cancannot (can’t)George can’t drive.
couldcould not (couldn’t)I couldn’t sleep last night.
mustmust not (mustn’t)I mustn’t forget to phone Jane.
shouldshould not (shouldn’t)You shouldn’t work so hard.
wouldwould not (wouldn’t)I wouldn’t like to be an actor.

B. don’t / doesn’t / didn’t

Present simple negative: I / we / you / they do not (don’t), he / she / it does not (doesn’t) + work / live / go etc. Past simple negative: I / they / he / she etc. did not (didn’t).

Phủ định hiện tại đơn: I / we / you / they do not (don’t), he / she / it does not (doesn’t) + work / live / go v.v. Phủ định quá khứ đơn: I / they / he / she v.v. did not (didn’t).

  • I want to go out. → I don’t want to go out.

    Tôi muốn ra ngoài. → Tôi không muốn ra ngoài.

  • They work hard. → They don’t work hard.

    Họ làm việc chăm chỉ. → Họ không làm việc chăm chỉ.

  • Lisa plays the guitar. → Lisa doesn’t play the guitar.

    Lisa chơi ghi-ta. → Lisa không chơi ghi-ta.

  • My father likes his job. → My father doesn’t like his job.

    Bố tôi thích công việc của mình. → Bố tôi không thích công việc của mình.

  • I got up early this morning. → I didn’t get up early this morning.

    Sáng nay tôi dậy sớm. → Sáng nay tôi không dậy sớm.

  • They worked hard yesterday. → They didn’t work hard yesterday.

    Hôm qua họ làm việc chăm chỉ. → Hôm qua họ không làm việc chăm chỉ.

  • We played tennis. → We didn’t play tennis.

    Chúng tôi chơi quần vợt. → Chúng tôi không chơi quần vợt.

  • Emily had dinner with us. → Emily didn’t have dinner with us.

    Emily ăn tối với chúng tôi. → Emily không ăn tối với chúng tôi.

C. Don’t … (imperative) and do as the main verb

C. Don’t … (mệnh lệnh) và do là động từ chính

  • Look! → Don’t look! / Wait for me. → Don’t wait for me.

    Nhìn kìa! → Đừng nhìn! / Đợi tôi. → Đừng đợi tôi.

Sometimes do is the main verb (don’t do / doesn’t do / didn’t do):

Đôi khi do là động từ chính (don’t do / doesn’t do / didn’t do):

  • Do something! → Don’t do anything!

    Làm gì đi chứ! → Đừng làm gì cả!

  • Sue does a lot at weekends. → Sue doesn’t do much at weekends.

    Cuối tuần Sue làm nhiều việc. → Cuối tuần Sue không làm gì nhiều.

  • I did what you said. → I didn’t do what you said.

    Tôi đã làm như bạn bảo. → Tôi không làm như bạn bảo.

mcq.question: He’s gone away. → He ___ away.
mcq.full: He’s gone away. → He hasn’t gone away.
mcq.vi: Anh ấy đã đi xa. → Anh ấy chưa đi xa.
mcq.expl:
Negative = auxiliary/modal + not (n’t): isn’t, aren’t, wasn’t, haven’t, won’t, can’t, couldn’t, shouldn’t …
Phủ định = trợ động từ/động từ khuyết thiếu + not (n’t): isn’t, aren’t, wasn’t, haven’t, won’t, can’t, couldn’t, shouldn’t …
Điểm ngữ pháp: has gone → hasn’t gone.
mcq.key: He’s gone away. → He ___ away.|hasn’t gone
